name: Julian Arahanga
bio: Julian Arahanga (born 18 December 1972) is a New Zealand actor and filmmaker, best known for playing Apoc in The Matrix.

credits.overview: Brings to light the harrowing experiences of survivors who endured abuse while in state care in New Zealand. Through candid interviews and personal narratives, the film delves into the systematic failures that led to countless individuals suffering, predominantly from Māori communities.
